English.Char_Desc_2000:
Faraja WebServer PRO ("Faraja" means "Comfort" in Swahili) is a portable local web development environment for Windows, distributed as a single EXE file that requires no installation.
Everything runs locally: Apache (8080), MariaDB (3306, root without password), PHP 8.2-8.4 via FastCGI, PostgreSQL (5432), Redis (6379), Nginx (80, reverse proxy with HTTPS), Node.js 20-24 and Python 3.11-3.13 project servers, Docker status and containers. Components download once and live next to the program in runtime/ and downloads/ folders.
Key features: service cards with Start/Stop/Restart and START ALL; VHost manager (Nginx block + Apache VirtualHost + hosts entry + per-domain SSL, https://myproject.local); built-in SQL editor and phpMyAdmin; PHP.ini editor; code editor with highlighting and minimap; cron-style task scheduler; Docker manager (containers, Compose, images, networks, volumes); Performance Lab (separate-process load tests with charts); Health Center diagnostics; staged updates with verification and rollback; 6 interface languages (RU/EN/ES/DE/FR/ZH); system tray; snapshots.
To start: run the EXE, tick components in the first-run wizard, press START ALL, open http://127.0.0.1:8080/. Free and open source under the Apache-2.0 license.
